description: This file defines an interface OrderService in Java for managing orders within the OpenMRS medical record system. It includes method signatures for creating, updating, retrieving, voiding, and deleting orders, order types, frequencies, groups, attributes, and related entities. It also contains constants and annotations for security privileges and metadata about order processing logic.

classes.name: OrderService
classes.description: Java interface defining the contract for order management operations in the OpenMRS API, including CRUD operations for orders, order types, frequencies, groups, attributes, and security privileges.
